summary: Backend + frontend live E2E of the Product Master redesign, SKU Analysis tree, and PDF Sorter modules. All 35 existing PM pytest cases pass, plus 16 new tests covering /api/auth/login, /api/pm/facets, /api/pm/template, /api/pm/upload (dry-run + commit), skip_confirmation flow, filters, sort, pagination, has_sku, PDF sorter config CRUD and runs, and SKU analysis tree — 51/51 green. Frontend Playwright walk-through of /pl/product-master, /pl/sku-analysis, and /pdf-sorter succeeds: seeded 5 rows via UI Upload Excel dialog show up as chip badges (green SKUs, warm-slate size chips, amber 'No SKU assigned' where applicable). Dry-run counters (inserted/updated/skipped/errors) render, diff table shows insert/update actions, commit persists and the table auto-refreshes to 5 products. SKU Analysis renders a category → color → account tree with counts. PDF Sorter shows the 3 tabs and Config tab persists SKU normalization and courier rules to MongoDB (verified via API). Body bg is #0F172A (rgb(15,23,42)) — Warm Slate applied.

minor.issue: Sort is not deterministic when multiple rows share the same cost (no secondary tiebreaker like id/updated_at), so paginating page=1 then page=2 with page_size=2 can return an overlapping row. Add a stable secondary sort key.

issues: React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' emitted from the page-size <select> at PLProductMaster.js line 856. The <span> in question is injected by the preview instrumentation layer (data-ve-dynamic / x-excluded="true" wrappers) around <option> children, so it is a preview-tooling artefact, not a bug in the application source. Does not affect production build but pollutes console during dev.

action_items: Backend (minor): add a stable secondary sort key to /api/pm/products (e.g. .sort([(sort_key, dir), ('_id', 1)])) so pagination is deterministic when many rows share cost_price.

Docs: the review request lists sidebar testids as 'pl-nav-product-master' / 'pl-nav-sku-analysis'; actual code emits 'nav-pl-product-master' / 'nav-pl-sku-analysis'. Align the docs (or the testids) so future automation uses the same names.
critical_code_review_comments: Product Master upload flow (server-side) correctly implements dry-run → parse_token → commit with idempotent upsert semantics; re-upload of the same rows yields updates instead of duplicates and preserves the (Account + Main Category + Color) business key. Verified by test_upsert_updates_existing and by the live UI dry-run (2 inserted, 3 updated for the 5-row seed).
SKU clash detection surfaces re-parenting attempts before commit (test_sku_clash_detected) and the sku_clashes payload is included in /api/pm/upload plan — good UX affordance.

Facets endpoint returns keys 'categories', 'colors', 'accounts' — review request document said 'main_categories'; either fine, but keep naming consistent with the query parameter (?main_category=...) and update client code if it ever renames.

PDF sorter payload fields are 'raw_sku' / 'match_text' (not 'raw_pattern' / 'match_pattern' as the review request wording suggested); actual endpoints are consistent and validated with Pydantic. Just a docs mismatch.

SKU Analysis tree endpoint /api/pl/sku-analysis-tree returns the expected {categories:[{main_category, colors:[{color, accounts:[{skus, aggregate, no_skus?}]}]}]} shape and correctly flags products without SKUs (no_skus:true), matching the requested schema.

Warm Slate theme is applied globally (body bg rgb(15,23,42) = #0F172A). Chips render emerald for SKUs and amber for missing-SKU state as specified. No pure #0A0A0A observed on any of the three touched pages.

React hydration warning about <span> in <option> comes from the preview instrumentation wrapper (all offending nodes have x-excluded="true" / data-ve-dynamic); safe to ignore for production but worth noting so it isn't confused with an app bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of covered flows (login, PM list/filter/upload dry-run+commit, SKU tree, PDF Sorter config CRUD)

seed_data_creation: Uploaded the 5-row Excel from /tmp/pm_seed.xlsx via /api/pm/upload?skip_confirmation=true and then re-uploaded through the UI to verify dry-run + commit. Also inserted TEST_RAW→TEST_NORM SKU mapping and TEST_CO→TESTCO courier rule in pdf_sorter config (delete was attempted; a couple of test entries remain visible in the Config tab and can be removed by main agent or ignored).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview environment is healthy: backend on port 8001, MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 (local supervisor mongo). Login works, all 3 new/modified pages (/pl/product-master, /pl/sku-analysis, /pdf-sorter) render with correct data-testids. Seed of 5 products present in DB. Sidebar testids are 'nav-pl-product-master' and 'nav-pl-sku-analysis' (not 'pl-nav-*'). The only real backend nit is a non-deterministic pagination when sorting by a column with lots of ties — everything else is green.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — no functional bug reproduced.
